distilled_hypothesis: Use baukit only as a mechanism donor for a tiny F2-native context-managed direct PyTorch forward-hook ActivationTap. Do not add baukit as a runtime dependency at E1. Bind exact F2 model/loader and causal experiment identities around the hook and keep all resulting activation/output observations as measurements, never truth/effect authority.
counterhypothesis: Native direct hooks may fail on generation/re-entrancy/compiled/distributed or quantized-offloaded runtimes; maintained intervention frameworks may prove worth their extra machinery after explicit E2/E3 measurement.
